practice.mastery[1]: Criticising the item is a booklet type, but the required splitting task is not. Also, ‘healthy’ is not necessarily leading: it can define the lunches being counted; the solution must not assert bias solely from that word or silently broaden the count to all canteen lunches.

summary: Replaced unsupported classification and minimum-question-set tasks with booklet-based criticisms, removed splitting demands, corrected the healthy-lunch criticism and drink-preference responses, and supplied booklet citations for every practice and quiz item. reviewSummary: All requested items have correct, usable solutions and assess questionnaire-design tasks asked in the supplied booklet. The theory matches the booklet's treatment of leading wording, ambiguity and insufficient response choices; no repairs or removals are required.
